Definition: neuter of a comparative of the base of G4226; interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that:--whether.
BiblicalUsage: Poteron asks whether, which of two. Jesus uses it once, at the feast: if any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that obedience is the way to knowledge, and the man who will do God's will finds out whether the teaching is God's.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
